hurried: plank timer w daily goal of 3 pls
fuller: I never hold a plank long enough, so I need: a Rest timer, a countdown labelled Plank, a bar chart of the last 7 days, and a list.

hurried: farm plot wheat or rice record pls
fuller: Wheat or Rice for each plot. Please include: a sown date, an expected harvest, bags of fertiliser, an irrigation count with a +1 button, and an actual yield in maund.

hurried: priorities grid urgent important both neither
fuller: A grid of two columns shows each quadrant, with Move and Done buttons on every task. A form at the bottom adds a new task. Urgent, Important, Both and Neither are the four choices.

hurried: supplier bills and payments owed
fuller: 2 forms, one for a bill and one for a payment, are on the Entries page. The Owed page shows a Total due line and each supplier's due amount. A form adds a supplier.

hurried: daily writing words count each day
fuller: A progress bar for today's words sits at the top against a 500 word goal, with a this week big number under it. A form and a list let me add or edit a page.

hurried: calls to mum weekly goal 2 pls
fuller: A month calendar where I tap each day I call, a day streak, and days since the last call, because I want to keep in touch with mum more often.

hurried: class list with numbers and parents
fuller: I need to know which child is which, so each kid has a number, a name, an optional parent and a count.

hurried: online orders new count
fuller: 1 big count per status, New, Packed, Shipped and Delivered, lets me see new orders at a glance. Open orders show below with a status choice on each.

hurried: garden jobs for each day of the week
fuller: A Today list with tick boxes, then a week section grouping tasks by day, with tap to edit.

hurried: how many push ups did i do this week?
fuller: I want a weekly push-up goal, so please include: a list of sets to tap or swipe, a this week total, a progress bar against 700, and a 7 day bar chart.

hurried: skincare done today pls with streaks
fuller: 1 tick box per care step, with each step's day streak next to it. A this week percent and a 30 day percent sit at the bottom. A heat map shows the last 70 days.

hurried: grocery list pls estimated total by cat
fuller: A form to add an item at the bottom, and a list sorted by category, with tick boxes and an Estimated total on top.

hurried: khata book who owes who pls
fuller: 1 total at the top, what people owe me, with each person showing owes you or you owe.

hurried: sunnah fast calendar tick
fuller: For someone keeping sunnah fasts, a button marks today as fasted, a count of this month's fasts, and a month calendar to tap, with a reminder on Sunday and Wednesday.

hurried: shop stock with buy and sell prices
fuller: For a small shop that sells items, each item has buy and sell prices and a qty. Sell 1 buttons log a sale. Sales today and profit today sit on top, with a low stock warning.

hurried: prayer checklist tick each one today
fuller: A form adds each prayer, and a tick box per prayer with a done count sits at the top.

hurried: grocery lst what to buy with prices
fuller: For a shopper who forgets the list at home, each item has a tick box, a quantity, and an optional price. A To buy count and total sit at the top. Items in the cart sit lower down.

hurried: hostel mess laundry pocket money per student
fuller: A big total this month sits on top, with each student's Mess, Laundry and Pocket spending listed beneath.

hurried: dua notes with count this month pls
fuller: A list of dua by day that I tap to edit or swipe to remove. The Add page holds a this month count, days since the last one, and a form.

hurried: daily standup log what i did and what is blocking
fuller: A Streak in days sits at the top, so I can see how long I have kept it going. A form asks what I did, what is planned and any blocker.

hurried: tifin for today and the week
fuller: I forget what tiffin is on which day, so Today's tiffin shows the item and drink for today. Each day's choice has an items count below it. A form adds a tiffin.

hurried: machine service reminders every 90 days
fuller: I have machines to keep serviced, so please include: a form to add a machine, a Serviced button when one is due, and a Last serviced line, for each machine.

hurried: customers served counter target 5
fuller: A drawing of circles and arcs I tap for each customer served, a Target reached notice at 5, and an Undo button for a tap I did not mean.

hurried: work owed this month
fuller: I do freelance jobs and forget who has not paid, so an Owed this month total sits at the top. Each job shows client, project, hours at a rate and a tick box for paid. A form adds a job.

hurried: how many drills did i do today?
fuller: A Today page counts drills done out of the total, with a tick box for each drill and a form to add one. Tap a drill to edit it, or swipe it to remove it.

hurried: jump rope counter for reps today with 500 goal
fuller: I need to keep moving, so one-tap buttons for 100, 200 and 500 reps, and a bar chart of the last 7 days.

hurried: baby routine checklist with a day streak
fuller: A Today page lists each routine with a tick box and its day streak, and a Stats page shows the percent done in 30 days, because the baby routine keeps changing.

hurried: packing list pls tick each item
fuller: A tick box per item and a packed count out of the total, with a form to add each thing.

hurried: where is my work expense claim money at?
fuller: Claims sorted by status: Draft, Submitted and Paid. Please include: each unpaid claim with its amount and a status choice, a total for each status, and a form to add a claim.

hurried: how many laps have i done today?
fuller: I need to see my progress each day, so a big number shows laps today, with a +1 lap button, a drawing of rectangles, an Undo button and an All time count.

hurried: bus fare log with weekly and monthly totals
fuller: 50 is the starting fare, and one-tap buttons add 100 or 200 at a tap. This month and This week totals sit above a list I can tap to fix or swipe away.

hurried: nap timer 20 min and naps today
fuller: I need a short rest in the day, so a Nap timer starts at 20 minutes and adds a nap when it ends. A today count sits on top. A bar chart of the last 7 days shows the pattern.

hurried: coffe runs wekly limit 3 with a counter
fuller: Each run out is a Log run tap, and the page shows a weekly limit of 3 as a progress bar. Please include a bar chart of the last 7 days and a list.

hurried: badmintn score ali vs sara plus 1 and 10
fuller: Ali and Sara each have a +1 and a +10 button, with totals above them. A Play to target of 21 shows a win message. Undo and New game are at the bottom.

hurried: cab log total fare today and km
fuller: Each ride has a km, a fare and Cash, Card or App for the pay type. Today totals show the fare, km and rides count, and a Cash in hand figure. A fill form logs litres and cost.

hurried: a spending tracker for my business costs each month
fuller: I need two pages. Please include: a Spend page with Safe to spend, an Over budget or Left to spend line, a progress bar, a form, and a Charts page with a list.

hurried: how many home meals have i cooked this week?
fuller: I want to eat in more, so please give me: a 7 day bar chart, a Log meal button, a this week count against 5, and a list of meals to tap or swipe.

hurried: sleep log with hours and a quality score
fuller: An Add page shows days since the last night, with a form to log hours and quality from 1 to 5. A Charts page has a list, and a reminder runs at 8:00 and 20:00 each day.

hurried: wedding guest list rsvp and seating
fuller: A grid of 10 seat numbers with guests on each, a gift list, and a Thank you page for guests who said yes.

hurried: household spend per category limits
fuller: 6 categories each with a limit, like 30000 for Rent, and a drawing of rectangles showing spend.

hurried: how much power have we used this month?
fuller: For a family tracking the meter, Units used this month and Last month lines show the change.

hurried: egg counter with buttons for 1, 2 and 6 eggs
fuller: I buy eggs in trays and forget how many I used, so one-tap buttons add 1, 2 or 6 eggs, and a bar chart shows the last 7 days of eggs.

hurried: which months of fees have i paid this year?
fuller: For a family paying school fees, a grid of 12 months shows what is paid this year, and a tap on a month marks it paid or removes it.

hurried: card game points for each player pls
fuller: Each player has a name, a total, and +10 and +1 buttons to add points, so the list shows everyone's score. A form adds a player and another adds a score.

hurried: coding hours this week and average
fuller: 0.5 to 16 hours can be logged each time. A big number shows this week's total and a second shows the 30 day average per entry. A form and list add and fix entries.

hurried: pocket money goal for each kid
fuller: A progress bar toward each kid's goal of 2000, with +50 and -50 buttons to add or take out money.

hurried: library book loans and when each one is due back
fuller: A list of open loans by return date, a tick box per book, a Done line at the bottom, and a 9:00 reminder the day before.

hurried: lucky draw names pick one
fuller: For a group that picks a winner at random, I add each name and tap Draw to choose one, with a Keep as winner button to save it. Past winners sit in a list at the bottom.

hurried: night journal gratitude count
fuller: 3 gratitude lines per entry, one for each of three things, plus a mood pick, because I want to end each night on a good note.

hurried: can i see how many minutes i studied this week?
fuller: I keep saying I will study more, so a progress bar shows minutes this week against an 840 minute goal, with a form to add a session and a list to tap or swipe.
